name: draft-update
description: saveDraft with draftId rewrites a draft that is in the Drafts folder (seeded here, so that its message id is known). Each update passes a new subject ending in v2 (except one), so that the new version can be told from the old one that stays in the mbox file until the folder is compacted: the changed fields replace, the omitted ones are kept (recipients, body, subject, reply headers, X-Priority, Reply-To, Content-Language), an empty cc clears the Cc line, a new body of a reply draft replaces only the typed text and keeps the cite line and the quote (plain and HTML), isHtml turns a plain draft into an HTML one when the whole body is replaced, from picks the sender. searchMessages on the Drafts folder shows that the old version is gone and lists one row per draft. Errors: unknown draft, a folder that is not a Drafts folder, an unknown folder, an attachment path that is refused, an encrypted draft (all refused without changing anything). A draft whose X-Identity-Key names an identity that no longer exists keeps the sender of its From line. Not covered: drafts of other accounts, what a compose window shows when it reopens the rewritten draft, attachments (see draft-update-attachments.json). Nothing is sent.
